propositions: _blame_file_commits returns [] on both git failure and successful-but-empty blame, making the two indistinguishable.
_blame_file_commits must be changed to return None on git failure and [] on a successful-but-empty blame.
derive_caused_by loops per path and can tally over a partial subset when blame fails on some paths, electing a wrong culprit and writing an incorrect caused_by link.
derive_caused_by must abort (return None) when any path's blame returns None, rather than deriving from a partial set.
A path that legitimately yields zero blame lines must not abort the derivation, preserving correct derivations.
Clone guidance doc must record measured blobless (--filter=blob:none) numbers and state that --filter=tree:0 must never be used, linked from the docs index.
